description: ADVANCED LIGHTING RUNG L3 -- GLOBAL ILLUMINANT INFERENCE. L2 crossed the spatially-varying illuminant by LOCALIZING the anchor, and its noise floor FAILED its own pre-registered rule at 13/1300 (1.0%) with an ARCHITECTURAL diagnosis: 12 of 13 leaks are surfaces that ARE their own locale's MAXIMUM, matched at residual EXACTLY 0.0, because ghat = a_loc/ra_loc renders the reference locale's maximum prototype onto a local maximum identically -- the WHITE-PATCH (ANCHOR) ASSUMPTION, localized. L3 CORROBORATES THE ANCHOR, which L2 named as a necessarily GLOBAL statement. l3_ghat makes each locale's illuminant estimate explicit (a CROSS-FRAME map, so a real value is correct); l3_pool forms ONE SCENE-LEVEL estimate by POOLING every locale's -- the CHEBYSHEV CENTER, the local estimate MOST CORROBORATED BY THE WHOLE SCENE (Argmin over locales of the MaxOver disagreement with every other locale), robust where a mean would be dragged by the very outlier it must catch, and the V4/PIT step over L2's V1/V2 local contrast; l3_corroborate then requires each locale's estimate to agree with the scene's within an envelope that FALLS OUT of L2's own per-adjacency drift budget scaled by the locale COUNT READ FROM THE DATA; l3_recognize is L2's verdict AND corroboration -- term for term l2_recognize plus ONE conjunct, so L3 can only SUBTRACT claims and L2's own arm on the SAME graph IS the exact pooling ABLATION; l3_refuse_uncorroborated / l3_refuse_bound make refusal a POSITIVE datum SPLIT BY REASON; and l3_recognize_lesioned is THE V4 DISSOCIATION -- the constancy stage removed entirely (ghat == 1), always computed on the same graph, so that colour DISCRIMINATION surviving while CONSTANCY is ABOLISHED is a MEASUREMENT. NO NEW RUST and NO NEW CONSTANT: the literal set is {0.0, 0.5, 1.0, 1.0e9}, identical to L2's; the bound is L1's OWN falls-out ONE LATTICE STEP inherited through L2. T3, L1, L1b and L2 are NOT modified -- L3 reads L2's stored locale statistics and writes only its own l3_*/l3l_* namespace. BOUNDED: ONE scene-level illuminant estimate with anchor corroboration. Shadow-vs-reflectance EDGE ATTRIBUTION (L4) and MULTI-ILLUMINANT scenes are NOT solved; reflectance is GIVEN at the abstract cone-triple grain; locale-grain registration and adjacency are GIVEN, not grown; IDENTITY correspondence is NOT given. Flag-gated on LightingL3Params.lighting_l3, OFF by default (sec 9 -- default 0 => byte-identical, seed inert), read ABSENCE-TOLERANTLY via MaxOver(default 0), never PickUnique. See VISION_LIGHTING_L3_PREREG.md.

microtheory.label: global illuminant inference: local estimates POOLED into one scene estimate that CORROBORATES the anchor it was built from

rules.name: l3_ghat
rules.comment: Writes the locale's OWN illuminant estimate ghat_loc = a_loc / ra_loc as an explicit per-channel float, from the statistics L2 ALREADY STORED on the locale (l2_a* from the locale's own membership, l2_ra* copied from its paired reference counterpart). L2 computes this same quotient INSIDE l2_recognize's render; L3 needs it as a first-class value because POOLING quantifies over it across locales, and a fold cannot reach inside another rule's expression. A REAL VALUE IS CORRECT HERE and is not a category error: ghat is a CROSS-FRAME MAP (test frame -> reference frame), and the frame/continuum invariant says in-frame coordinates are integers while the maps BETWEEN frames may be real. The surfaces' cones stay integers throughout. Guarded on l2_paired (so it only ever runs on a test locale that L2's own join has already paired -- the reference frame's locales are never paired and never get an estimate) and on ra > 0 on EVERY channel, so a degenerate reference locale REFUSES by never acquiring an estimate rather than dividing by zero. The l3_ghat_done guard makes it fire once per locale so run_rules converges. Flag-gated, OFF by default (sec 9).

rules.name: l3_pool
rules.comment: THE GLOBAL ILLUMINANT INFERENCE -- ONE scene-level estimate POOLED from every locale's local estimate. The pool is the CHEBYSHEV CENTER: Argmin over the frame's locales of (MaxOver every other locale of the L-infinity disagreement between their estimates). In words: THE LOCAL ESTIMATE THAT IS MOST CORROBORATED BY THE WHOLE SCENE -- the one whose worst disagreement with any other locale is smallest. WHY A CHEBYSHEV CENTER AND NOT A MEAN: a mean is dragged by an outlier, so a single locale with a wrong anchor would move the very estimate that is supposed to CATCH wrong anchors; the center is robust, and the corroboration it supports is therefore not self-defeating. It is also the held Argmin -- 'bins propose, continuous decides' -- applied one level up, to LOCALES rather than to prototypes, and it introduces NO NEW CONSTANT. THIS IS THE V4/PIT STEP: local double-opponent contrast (L2) is only the first step; the local estimates must be POOLED over a large receptive field into a scene-level illuminant before constancy exists. Every locale participates in every candidate's score, so this is a genuinely GLOBAL statement and not another local one. Fires ONCE per test frame, and only after EVERY one of its locales has an estimate -- a genuine Not(Exists a locale still missing one), so the pool is never formed from a partial scene. l3_n_loc records the locale COUNT from the DATA; the corroboration envelope scales with it, which is why nothing here is a magic number. Matched through compares_to so it only ever runs on a TEST frame. Flag-gated, OFF by default (sec 9).

rules.name: l3_corroborate
rules.comment: CORROBORATES THE LOCAL ANCHOR AGAINST THE WHOLE SCENE -- the fix L2 NAMED and refused to bolt on (sec 5). L2's ghat_loc = a_loc/ra_loc ASSUMES the test locale's maximum is the SAME MATERIAL as the reference locale's maximum. When that assumption is wrong, ghat_loc is wrong by a REFLECTANCE RATIO, and the locale then renders its own maximum onto itself at residual EXACTLY 0.0 -- which is precisely L2's measured 13/1300 leak, 12 of them local maxima. The corroboration: the locale's estimate must agree with the POOLED SCENE estimate to within the falls-out N-scaled envelope, on EVERY channel. A locale whose anchor is a different material produces an estimate the rest of the scene does not support, and is refused. WHY THIS IS NOT l2_slowvar AGAIN: slowvar is PAIRWISE and ADJACENT, and L2 measured it STRICTLY MORE CONSERVATIVE than the exact verdict, which is why it gates nothing there. This clause is LOOSER locally (the envelope scales with N) and yet catches something no amount of local adjacency-checking can see: a wrong anchor IDENTITY is a reflectance error, not a field slope, and only a GLOBAL estimate exposes it. The l3_corr guard makes it fire once per locale so run_rules converges. Flag-gated, OFF by default (sec 9).

rules.name: l3_recognize
rules.comment: THE GLOBALLY-CORROBORATED LIGHTING INVARIANT. A surface is recognized iff (a) its locale was PAIRED by L2's join, (b) THE LOCALE'S ANCHOR WAS CORROBORATED BY THE POOLED SCENE ESTIMATE, and (c) the best candidate in the reference frame's held codebook, rendered at the LOCAL illuminant estimate, lies within ONE LATTICE STEP on every channel. (c) IS L2's ENTIRE VERDICT, TERM FOR TERM. (b) IS THE ONLY ADDITION. THAT IS WHAT MAKES L2's OWN l2_* ARM THE EXACT POOLING ABLATION (sec 13.2), read off the SAME graph in the SAME tick: it is this rule minus the corroboration conjunct and nothing else, so no duplicate ablation rule is shipped and the contrast is ONE measurement rather than two experiments. It also means L3 can only ever SUBTRACT claims from L2 and can NEVER widen an invariance class -- an admitted L3 row is byte-identical to L2's own answer on that row. l3_ncand records the number of candidates INSIDE the bound (rung L1b's lesson: reporting only the winner's residual hid a bound that never bound). MinOver carries an explicit NO_CANDIDATE default so an EMPTY codebook REFUSES rather than silently admitting (sec 1.1). Flag-gated, OFF by default (sec 9).

rules.name: l3_refuse_uncorroborated
rules.comment: Marks l3_status='l3_refused_uncorroborated' for a surface whose locale was paired and whose frame was pooled, but whose ANCHOR THE SCENE DOES NOT CORROBORATE. THIS IS THE RUNG'S OWN CONTRIBUTION MADE VISIBLE: it is exactly the population L2 would have admitted on an assumed anchor. Splitting refusal BY REASON (this rule) from refusal by the render's bound (l3_refuse_bound) means the readback distinguishes 'the pool rejected the anchor' from 'the bound rejected the render', so the leak-closing mechanism is auditable from the results file rather than inferred. A refusal is a POSITIVE datum (sec 1.1 clause 4): without these rules 'refused' and 'never ran' are indistinguishable. Flag-gated, OFF by default (sec 9).

rules.name: l3_refuse_bound
rules.comment: Marks l3_status='l3_refused_bound' for a surface whose locale WAS corroborated but whose best rendered candidate exceeds the lattice-step bound. This is L2's own refusal condition, inherited unchanged; together with l3_refuse_uncorroborated and l3_recognize it PARTITIONS every surface whose locale was paired, so the readback is total and no surface silently falls through. Flag-gated, OFF by default (sec 9).

rules.name: l3_recognize_lesioned
rules.comment: THE V4 LESION: THE CONSTANCY STAGE REMOVED, AND NOTHING ELSE CHANGED. Identical to l3_recognize term-for-term except that the illuminant map is GONE -- the held prototype is compared to the observation RAW, ghat == 1, no anchor, no ratio, no pooling. The same codebook, the same L-infinity verdict, the same inherited ONE-LATTICE-STEP bound, the same Argmin. It writes its own l3l_* namespace and is ALWAYS computed when the flag is on, so the intact-vs-lesioned contrast is read from ONE graph in ONE run. WHAT IT IS FOR: V4 damage leaves colour DISCRIMINATION intact but ABOLISHES colour CONSTANCY -- the two are separable stages in the biology, and that dissociation is the sharpest available check that this rung built the constancy stage and not merely a stricter filter. The prediction is DOUBLE and both halves are measured: under the REFERENCE illuminant the lesioned arm must still tell distinct materials apart (discrimination INTACT -- it is the identity map, so the codebook still separates); under a CHANGED illuminant it must fail to recognize the same materials (constancy ABOLISHED) while the intact arm holds. A lesion that killed BOTH would mean the arm is simply dead (sec 1.1 clause 4) and the dissociation would be worthless -- which is exactly why the discrimination half is measured and not assumed. Flag-gated, OFF by default (sec 9).
